_meta.title: uhta canon rules registry
_meta.note: Single source the pipelines' Evaluators read their law from. A rule is UPHELD (default, enforced as written), AMENDED (Director-edited text/params enforced instead, baseline kept for history), or REPEALED (not enforced; the skip is logged). There is deliberately no IGNORED/WAIVED status — ruled off the bench by the Director, 2026-08-19: silent bypasses make run logs untrustworthy. Rulings live in canon/CANON-RULING.json, written by the Bible page; the pipelines never edit this file.

rules.title: Encounter law — wordless, diegetic, pole-asymmetric
rules.text: GDD §2, Encounters: when you meet a group directly the simulation pauses and you play a short, wordless, diegetic exchange — 'no interface, no text, only your body and theirs'. 'This is the only time you act on individuals rather than a population', and 'the two poles never play the same game': Hope plays patience, depth, few (converts arrive devout); Fear plays speed, force, many (converts are shallow). A design that needs a HUD, a label, or a word has failed; a design whose Hope and Fear versions are the same game reskinned has failed.
rules.enforced_by: Designer/Judge/Refiner prompts ({{RULES}}); judge classes NOT-DIEGETIC and POLE-SYMMETRY cite it
rules.why_not_repealable: The Judge cannot judge against no law. Amend the text instead.

rules.title: Buildable inputs — the slice's input vocabulary
rules.enforced_by: checks.py C3 — controls ⊆ this list, else deterministic fail
rules.why_not_repealable: A fact of the build, not a preference. Amend the list when the build grows an input.

rules.title: Real stakes — the sim's outcome vocabulary
rules.enforced_by: checks.py C4 — effects ⊆ this list, else deterministic fail
rules.why_not_repealable: Stakes must pay in currencies the sim has. Amend the list when the sim grows one.

rules.title: C5 WORDLESS — no interface vocabulary in player-facing fields
rules.source: GDD §2: 'no interface, no text, only your body and theirs'
rules.enforced_by: checks.py C5 (deterministic) + the Judge's NOT-DIEGETIC class
rules.note: The pending HUD amendment targets this rule. Repealing it lets designs name HUD/text; the encounter-law prose (mg-encounter-rules) should be amended in the same ruling so the Judge's law agrees.

rules.title: Narration register — the §2.5 law
rules.text: Short, declarative, second person. Names the verb and states its consequence. Instrumentation, not lore — GDD §2.5: 'short declarative lines, no mythology'. No interface language: this is a wordless game's one narrated cycle, not a tutorial overlay — the narrator names what the being DOES, never which key the player presses. No numbers (§2.3, banded display).
rules.why_not_repealable: The narration pipeline's whole law. Amend, don't delete.

rules.title: R3 length caps for narration lines
R2 NO-UI-LANGUAGE — narration never names keys
rules.source: GDD §2.5 corollary; the guide() baseline-audit catch
rules.enforced_by: ger/checks.py run_register_checks R2 (also gates Instructor lines)
rules.note: Instructor lines run through this same gate. If the instruction-text amendment passes, prefer scoping via amendment over repeal so narration lines stay wordless.

proposals.title: Encounter-scoped HUD
proposals.context: Six playtests: fully wordless was undiscoverable and illegible until presentation passes approached HUD-ness in diegetic clothing (the ember ring IS a target indicator).

options.label: HUD allowed, encounter-scoped only — overlay while the world is paused; overworld stays HUD-free (C5 becomes HUD-SCOPE, NOT-DIEGETIC becomes NOT-SCOPED)
HUD may persist into the overworld view
No HUD — uphold the wordless rule as written

proposals.title: Instruction text in encounters
proposals.context: 'And text instructions I think.' The Instructor agent already writes one register-gated line; this rules on how much text, and when.

options.label: Instructions always shown while the encounter is active
First N plays, then fading — training wheels that come off
Only during the sleep-0 narrated window, matching verb teaching

proposals.title: Repeat circumstances
proposals.context: 'It's ok if the games repeat under specific circumstances.' Current build arms once per band (shown_tip / arm-once).

options.label: A failed encounter may be retried with the same band
Once per band per generation (re-arms after Sleep)
Once per settlement per era for holdings; bands stay once-only
